_readme: Translator context for en.json (NOT bundled into the app). key → note: where the text shows, what {{placeholders}} are, and 'tight' = very little space, prefer the shortest natural word. Plural keys are listed by base name (without _one/_other). Card letters A/J/Q/K, the names Soli, Vegas and Klondike, the $ sign and digits stay as they are unless the glossary says otherwise.
nav.play: Drawer menu item that opens the game screen. tight
nav.hello: Drawer menu item + header title of the About screen. Deliberately a friendly 'Hello', not 'About'.
nav.history: Drawer menu item for the list of past games. tight
nav.settings: Drawer menu item + header title of the settings screen. tight
nav.rate: Drawer menu item that opens the store page to rate the app. 'Soli' is the app name.
nav.openMenu: Screen-reader label of the menu (hamburger) button in the header.
nav.notFoundTitle: Header title of the fallback screen for an unknown link (rarely seen).
nav.notFoundBody: Body text of the unknown-link fallback screen.
nav.notFoundLink: Link on the unknown-link fallback screen that returns to the game.
common.cancel: Cancel button in confirmation dialogs (new game, retry deal, reset Vegas total). Use the platform's standard word. tight (Android truncates long dialog buttons)
common.reset: Destructive confirm button of the 'Reset Vegas total?' dialog. tight
common.off: Picker option meaning the feature is switched off (Scoring: Off, Warnings: Off). tight
common.drawMode: Name of the draw mode: how many cards are turned from the stock per tap. {{number}} is 1–5 ('Draw 3'). NOT a plural: it names a mode, like a product option. Shown in the settings picker and in history rows. tight
about.madeBy: About screen. Directly followed by the author's handle '@carimatia' as a link. If your language needs the name first, phrase it as a label (like 'Author:').
about.dedication: About screen, personal dedication by the author. 'T' is his girlfriend's initial; keep it. Translate naturally, keep the warm tone.
about.pitch: About screen, one-line description of the app. 'Free' = costs nothing.
about.sourceLink: About screen, tappable link to the source code repository on GitHub.
about.promise: About screen: what the app deliberately does not have.
game.newGame: Button that starts a new game: in the header of the game screen and in the bottom dock. tight (header button on small phones)
game.newGameA11y: Screen-reader label of the header 'New Game' button.
game.undo: Bottom dock button: take back the last move. Use the platform's standard word for Undo. tight
game.hint: Bottom dock button: show the next move. tight
game.draw: Caption printed on the back of the stock pile's top card (tap to draw). 11 px on a playing-card-sized area, clipped when too long. tight (ideally ≤ 6 characters)
game.recyclesLeft: Vegas games: caption on the empty stock slot saying how many more times the waste can be turned over. {{count}} = remaining passes. tight (ideally ≤ 8 characters)
game.newGameAlert.title: Title of the confirmation dialog before a new game is dealt.
game.newGameAlert.message: Dialog body when the player asks for a new game mid-game.
game.newGameAlert.messageWon: Dialog body shown after a win.
game.newGameAlert.confirm: Confirm button of the new-game dialog: deals a new game. tight (dialog button)
game.playDeal.retryTitle: Dialog title when replaying a deal from History from scratch.
game.playDeal.retryConfirm: Confirm button of the retry dialog. tight (dialog button)
game.playDeal.sharedTitle: Dialog title when the player opened a deal link someone shared.
game.playDeal.sharedConfirm: Confirm button: play the shared deal. tight (dialog button)
game.playDeal.message: Body of both dialogs above: what happens to the game in progress.
notice.unwinnable: Warning bubble above the dock when the game can provably no longer be won. The strong claim. Also read aloud by screen readers.
notice.stuck: Warning bubble when the stock is played out and no useful move is left. Deliberately the WEAKER wording than notice.unwinnable (it does not claim the game is lost) — keep the two clearly different.
notice.noHint: Short bubble after pressing Hint when no hint is available right now.
notice.undoTip: One-time tip bubble pointing at the Undo button. The gesture is a sideways DRAG (not a long press) — the verb must say drag/slide. 'Time travel' = moving back and forth through the moves of the game; avoid jargon like 'scrub'.
hud.score: Badge label above the Standard score on the game screen. Shown UPPERCASE in 10 px. tight (≤ 8 characters)
hud.vegas: Badge label above the Vegas result of this game (dollars). 'Vegas' is the scoring mode's name. tight
hud.total: Badge label above the running Vegas total across games. tight (≤ 8 characters)
hud.moves: Badge label above the move counter. tight (≤ 8 characters)
hud.time: Badge label above the game timer. tight (≤ 8 characters)
hud.badgeA11y: Screen-reader text of one badge: {{label}} is one of the hud labels above, {{value}} its spoken value ('Score, 385', 'Time, 3 minutes 12 seconds').
hud.vegasSpoken: Screen-reader form of a Vegas amount of zero or more. {{count}} = whole dollars.
hud.vegasSpokenNegative: Screen-reader form of a negative Vegas amount ('minus 47 dollars'). {{count}} = the absolute number of dollars.
time.hours: Screen-reader duration part, joined through time.join: '1 hour 2 minutes 5 seconds'.
time.join: Pattern that joins two screen-reader duration parts; applied left to right, so three parts become ((hours + minutes) + seconds). {{first}} / {{second}} are finished parts such as '1 hour' and '2 minutes'. English uses a plain space. Keep the plain space unless your language needs a linking word between the parts (Arabic «و»).
settings.section.newGames: Settings section title: options that apply from the next game on.
settings.section.gameplay: Settings section title: options for playing.
settings.section.statistics: Settings section title: which counters the game screen shows.
settings.cardsDrawn: Settings row label next to the Draw 1–5 picker.
settings.solvableDeals: Settings switch: only deal games that are known to be winnable. Forbidden words: solver, catalog, heuristic.
settings.scoring.label: Settings row label of the scoring picker (Off / Standard / Vegas).
settings.scoring.description: Small text under the scoring picker while Off or Standard is selected. One plain line on purpose.
settings.scoring.vegasDescription: Small text under the scoring picker while Vegas is selected: says ONLY what is switched off and when it applies — do not explain the Vegas rules.
settings.scoring.standard: Picker option: classic point scoring. tight
settings.scoring.vegas: Picker option: Vegas scoring (dollars, limited passes). A name. tight
settings.vegasTotal.label: Settings switch shown while Vegas is selected: keep a running balance across games.
settings.vegasTotal.description: Small text under that switch. 'The header' = the badge at the top of the game screen. Deliberately explicit.
settings.vegasTotal.resetLabel: Button that resets the running Vegas total.
settings.vegasTotal.resetTitle: Title of the confirmation dialog for that reset.
settings.vegasTotal.resetMessage: Body of that dialog. '$0' stays as is. 'The game on the board' = the game currently in progress.
settings.autoUp: Settings switch: cards are moved up to the foundations automatically when it is safe. Short feature name.
settings.hintButton.label: Settings switch: show the Hint button on the game screen.
settings.warnings.label: Settings row label of the warnings picker.
settings.warnings.description: Small text under the warnings picker; explains the two warning levels in one line.
settings.warnings.noUsefulMoves: Picker option: warn when no useful move is left. This is the widest text in the picker. tight
settings.warnings.unwinnable: Picker option: warn as soon as the game cannot be won any more. tight
settings.showMoves: Settings switch: show the move counter badge.
settings.showTime: Settings switch: show the timer badge.
history.title: Header title of the History screen.
history.stats.games: Tile label above the number of games played. Three tiles share one row. tight
history.stats.solved: Tile label above the number of games won. tight
history.stats.incomplete: Tile label above the number of games not finished. tight
history.status.solved: Status word on a history row: the game was won.
history.status.incomplete: Status word on a history row: the game was abandoned.
history.status.active: Status word on a history row: the game currently in progress.
history.dealName: Title of a row in the History list and of the game detail sheet: the name of one dealt game. {{code}} is the deal's fixed code like '2345-6789' (letters/digits, never translated). 'Deal' is the noun (a dealt game), same term as in 'Deal Again'. One line next to the status word. tight
history.moves: Segment of a history row's detail line: number of moves of that game.
history.score: Segment of the detail line: Standard score. {{value}} is a formatted number.
history.vegas: Segment of the detail line: Vegas result. {{value}} is an amount like '−$17'.
history.solvable: Segment of the detail line: this deal was dealt as a guaranteed-winnable deal.
history.emptyTitle: Title shown when the history list is empty.
history.emptyBody: Text under that title. 'Klondike' is the solitaire variant Soli plays.
history.loadingTitle: Title while the history is loading.
history.justNow: Shown instead of a date when a row has no timestamp yet. Lowercase in English because it sits in a line of details.
history.today: Date of a history row from today. {{time}} is a localized clock time.
history.yesterday: Date of a history row from yesterday. {{time}} is a localized clock time.
history.dateTime: Date of an older row this year: {{date}} is a short localized date ('Jul 6'), {{time}} a clock time. Only the separator/order is yours.
history.retry: Button in the history detail sheet: play this deal again from the start. tight
history.share: Button in the history detail sheet: share a link to this deal. Use the platform's standard word. tight
share.dealMessage: Text sent together with a deal link via the system share sheet. {{number}} is the draw mode 1–5 (same wording as common.drawMode). 'Klondike' and 'Soli' are names.
a11y.rank.1: Spelled-out card rank for screen readers (Ace). Ranks 1–13 are combined with a suit through a11y.card.
a11y.suit.clubs: Suit name as used inside a card name (a11y.card). ♣
a11y.suit.diamonds: Suit name as used inside a card name. ♦
a11y.suit.hearts: Suit name as used inside a card name. ♥
a11y.suit.spades: Suit name as used inside a card name. ♠
a11y.card: Pattern for a spoken card name. Reorder freely (e.g. suit first) and add the grammar your language needs.
a11y.tableauCard: Screen-reader label of a face-up card in a column. {{card}} = a11y.card result, {{column}} = column number 1–7.
a11y.faceDownCard: Screen-reader label of a face-down card. {{column}} = column number 1–7.
a11y.emptyColumn: Screen-reader label of an empty column.
a11y.stock: Screen-reader label of the stock (draw pile). {{count}} = cards left in it.
a11y.stockEmpty: Screen-reader label of the stock when stock and waste are both empty.
a11y.stockExhausted: Vegas games: the stock is empty and no further pass through it is allowed.
a11y.stockRecycle: Screen-reader label of the empty stock slot; tapping turns the waste pile back into the stock.
a11y.stockRecycleLeft: Same as a11y.stockRecycle on a Vegas game. {{count}} = how many more times this is allowed.
a11y.waste: Screen-reader label of the waste pile (drawn cards). {{card}} = its top card.
a11y.foundationPile.clubs: Name of the clubs foundation pile (where clubs are built up from the Ace). Used inside a11y.foundation / a11y.foundationEmpty.
a11y.foundationPile.diamonds: Name of the diamonds foundation pile.
a11y.foundationPile.hearts: Name of the hearts foundation pile.
a11y.foundationPile.spades: Name of the spades foundation pile.
a11y.foundation: Screen-reader label of a foundation pile with cards. {{pile}} = a11y.foundationPile.*, {{card}} = top card.
a11y.foundationEmpty: Screen-reader label of an empty foundation pile.
a11y.scrubber: Screen-reader label of the undo timeline slider. {{position}} = current step, {{total}} = number of steps.
a11y.hint.draw: Read aloud when the hint says: draw from the stock.
a11y.hint.toColumn: Read aloud for a hint. {{card}} = spoken card name, {{column}} = column number 1–7.
a11y.hint.toFoundation: Read aloud for a hint that plays a card to its foundation pile.
